title: Allow context warnings to be configurable
body: 20% is too low given how much performance drops off. It used to be 40%. It would be good if there was a setting to set the percentage when the warning comes up - or a way to configure this via the status bar agent. The context command is useful, but it's manual. The less friction the better.
author: jrp685

top_comments.author: coygeek
top_comments.body:
